text:
Mira: opened PR to tidy streaming pagination + retries examples across py/ts/go. includes compact dedupe pattern and non-blocking retry helper. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/900
Alex: Nice. can we keep the TS generator and an EventEmitter example? also add a one-line migration note about cursor TTL.
Sam: +1 for dedupe snippet. added a tiny python example that persists only the latest resume_token and checks token IDs to avoid duplicates.
Owen: CI flagged gofmt and an unused import in the Go snippet. I'll push a small fix and run gofmt.
Mira: added changelog line and a short paragraph in migration guide comparing resume vs offset. also linked internal eval that caught partial overlap.
docs-bot: link-checker: 4/4 OK. docs-lint: warning long line in ts example (wrap suggested).
Owen: pushed gofmt fix. replaced unused import and switched to context cancellation pattern. CI green now.
Alex: left minor wording nit on "resume_token" naming; changed for consistency. LGTM.
Mira: thanks all; merging and backporting to release/v1.8 as docs-only. will announce in #integrations with brief examples summary.
Sam: filing follow-up issue to add an e2e reconnect example in examples repo.
Mira: great — thanks everyone!
